answer.en: An electric scooter is a two-wheeler powered by a rechargeable battery and an electric motor. It produces zero tailpipe emissions and runs quietly compared to petrol scooters.

question.en: How do I charge an electric scooter?

answer.en: Most electric scooters come with a portable charger that plugs into any standard household socket. Simply connect the charger to the scooter and plug it in. Charging times vary by model.

question.en: What is the approximate running cost of an electric scooter?

answer.en: Electric scooters are significantly cheaper to run than petrol scooters. Electricity costs for a full charge are typically a fraction of what petrol would cost for the same distance. Exact costs depend on your local electricity rate and the scooter model.
